selectionHint: A few exceptional experiences. One seamless plan.
detailsHint: Tell us how to reach you. We’ll take care of the details.
emptyHint: Explore Miami’s yachts, exotic cars and unforgettable experiences. Save your favorites here and bring your plans together.
extrasHint: Optional extras for your whole selection.
securityNote: Security scope and pricing will be confirmed separately.
requestNote: Your concierge will confirm availability and the complete price. Nothing is charged in this step.
mixedNote: Price-on-request services and extras are excluded from the amounts shown. Their price and availability will follow under the same order number and require your approval.
balanceNote: The remaining balance is due before your experience; your concierge will confirm the timing.
contactHint: We use these details to coordinate your selected experiences.
depositHint: Secure your booking with a deposit.
whatsappNote: We save your request, then open your WhatsApp draft. Review it and tap Send to start the conversation.
secureNote: Payment is completed securely through Stripe. Availability and prices are checked again before payment.
savedNote: Your selection stays saved in this browser.
quoteFailed: Your request could not be saved. Your selection is still here. Please try again or contact your concierge.
clearConfirm: Remove every experience from your selection?
phoneError: Enter a valid phone number with 7–15 digits, including the country code.
inquirySummary: {n} experiences for your concierge to confirm
bookingUnavailable: This experience is already booked for the selected dates. Please choose different dates.
fullKlarnaHint: Klarna available for full payment, subject to eligibility. Price-on-request services excluded.
